title: Gantry Crane

introduction.definition: A gantry crane has a bridge (one or two girders) supported on legs that run on rails at ground level. A trolley (crab) with a hoist travels across the girders, and the whole gantry travels along the rails, so the hook can reach any point in a rectangular area. It is used outdoors or where no building structure can carry a runway.
key_points: Duty classification (ISO 4301 / FEM / CMAA) sets design
Limit switches and load limiters are essential
introduction.summary: A gantry crane is an overhead crane supported on legs that run on ground rails. The trolley (crab) runs along the girders and its hoist raises and lowers the hook; the whole gantry travels along the runway. Used in yards, ports and workshops.

foundation: Runway beams, columns or pillar foundations designed for the crane wheel/moment loads including dynamic and test loads (structural engineer sign-off).
alignment: Rails/beams within span, level and straightness tolerances; end stops and buffers fitted.
piping: Power supply via conductor rails, festoon or cable reel; mainline isolator accessible; pendant or radio control labelled with directions.
commissioning: Function-test all motions and limit switches (hoist upper/lower, travel); check brakes; proof load test and thorough examination by a competent person before first use, per the applicable standard and local regulations.

routine.task: Pre-use check: limits, brakes, rope, hook latch.

periodic.task: Inspect ropes, sheaves, wheels and rails.

overhaul.task: Thorough examination by a competent person; overhaul hoist gearbox and brakes.

lubrication: Gearboxes: oil to grade and change interval; open gears and slew bearing: grease to schedule.
Wheels and pulley bearings: grease to schedule.
Wire rope: lubricate with rope dressing.

causes: Wear on sheaves/drum, overload, poor spooling
remedies: Inspect and discard per criteria (ISO 4309); correct reeving

safety: Never stand under a suspended load; use trained slingers; check wind speed limits; storm-lock outdoor cranes.

video_tutorials.title: Gantry Crane — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Gantry Crane.
A gantry crane has a bridge (one or two girders) supported on legs that run on rails at ground level.
A trolley (crab) with a hoist travels across the girders, and the whole gantry travels along the rails, so the hook can reach any point in a rectangular area.
It is used outdoors or where no building structure can carry a runway.
Typical applications include shipyards and container terminals; precast concrete and steel stockyards; power plants and dams (maintenance); rail yards.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Gantry Crane — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Gantry Crane.
Pre-use check: limits, brakes, rope, hook latch.
Inspect ropes, sheaves, wheels and rails.
Thorough examination by a competent person; overhaul hoist gearbox and brakes.
Watch for wire rope damage: broken wires, kinks, corrosion. Common cause: wear on sheaves/drum, overload, poor spooling.
Watch for brake failure: load drift, increased stopping distance. Common cause: worn linings, contamination, wrong adjustment.
Watch for overload: trip of limiter, structural deformation. Common cause: unknown load weight, side pulling.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
